judgments.label: uncertain
judgments.rationale: The first carousel slide's image link (a > figure > img alt="Imagem Destacada"). The capture's CDP accessibility tree shows role link with no name, while the img inside is named "Imagem Destacada": Chromium does not take name from content through a figure, so in Chrome and Edge the link is exposed with an empty name, as the claim says. But the markup is valid and the accessible name computation spec (recursive name from content) would give "Imagem Destacada", which other browsers and axe-core compute, so competent auditors would reasonably disagree on whether this is an author failure of 4.1.2 or a user-agent gap. Separately, the image alt fails 1.1.1/2.4.4 for not naming the story. The live HTML is the same, so the capture does not differ.
